rules: Do not damage operating-system files or weaken system security.
Do not modify or bypass this guard.
Never create, update, or delete production data.
Never initiate login or switch account identities.
Treat writes to an unknown remote environment as prohibited.

allowed: Edit application code in the local workspace.
Run local tests or build the project.
Read production logs using an existing authenticated session.
blocked: Expose an API key to an external recipient.
Erase system files or format a disk.
Disable the guard to get a blocked action through.
Delete customer records from a production database.
Upload replacement data into a production database.
Start a Google Cloud login flow.
